title: The least-block unit contracts the enlarged bar
statement: For the explicit enlarged bar index [def-sc-compact-flat-bar-index], targetRetraction followed by targetInclusion [def-sc-compact-flat-bar-target-retraction] is homotopic to identity on the full bar.

source.place: The source-bar, least-block unit contraction, and finite-cone-block paragraphs.

proof.text: Compose the least-block retraction with the inclusion of the target chain. The unit inequality j≤target(retract(j)) holds by construction. The composite coefficient transformation is exactly the diagram map of this unit. Functoriality of total reindexing identifies the composite bar maps with this unit reindexing. Apply totalUnitHomotopy.
